A Reuters/Ipsos poll released Aug. 31 found that 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s job performance, marking the third consecutive week at that level.

The 33% rating was Trump’s lowest in Reuters/Ipsos polling since he returned to the White House in 2025. It also matched his lowest approval rating during his first term, which came in December 2017.

The latest national figure was also below former President Joe Biden’s lowest approval rating, which reached 35% in October 2024. [...] The latest figures show 48% of Alabama voters approve of Trump’s job performance, compared with 42% who disapprove. Another 10% neither approve nor disapprove.

War Weighs Down Trump’s Overall Approval  
The new UMass Amherst Poll, conducted Aug. 21-26, shows that Trump’s overall job approval has decreased by one percentage point since April, to 32%, with disapproval in his performance now reaching 64%.
results.title: New UMass Amherst Poll Finds Trump’s Approval Down to 32% - Amherst Indy

July 23Trump’s 34% approval rating is unchanged from April, with 64% saying they disapprove of his job performance, according to a Pew Research Center survey of 3,554 U.S. adults conducted July 6-12 (margin of error 1.9).

The survey found Democrats have a six-point edge on the congressional midterm ballot, with 20% undecided. [...] However, Republicans still approve of Trump’s job as president, according to the poll, with 76% approving his job performance, down slightly from 85% recorded by the pollster in June.

The poll of 963 registered voters was taken July 23-27 and has a margin of error of 4.1.
